rationale: The agent did not follow key policy steps and did not fully satisfy the user’s request. Issues: (1) No visible authentication of the user before accessing or modifying account/order data. (2) Did not provide the requested gift card balance. (3) Did not answer clearly which card was used for the recent order, only implied Mastercard by mentioning a refund. (4) Did not address whether the gift card balance could be applied to the order before changing payment method. (5) Per policy, any order-changing action requires explicit confirmation; the agent performed modify_pending_order_payment and reported it as already changed without confirming. (6) Stated a specific refund timeline (5–7 business days) without tool-backed evidence. Given these, the conversation fails the pass bar.
